events.title: Kratos Defense Q1 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
events.body: KTOS beats Q1 estimates as adjusted EPS rises to 16 cents, and revenues jump 22.6% to $371 million, with the backlog climbing to $1.635 billion.

events.title: Woodward's Q2 Earnings & Revenues Beat Estimates, Increase Y/Y
events.body: WWD posts 34% EPS surge and 23% sales growth in Q2, beats estimates and lifts exercice 2026 outlook on strong Aerospace and Industrial demand.
